title: Electron-beam Readiness Check on In-line Defect Inspection SEM Tool in Semiconductor High-Volume Manufacturing Industry Using Advanced Edge Derivative Algorithm
content: Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) has played a critical role in the semiconductor technical development and high-volume manufacturing industry for several decades. Its importance continues to grow as device dimensions shrink, requiring greater precision and accuracy in defect detection. Among the key application areas of SEM tools, defect inspection is particularly vital for maintaining high production yields. These tools are designed to detect both electrical and physical defects with a broader operating range and higher throughput compared to their metrology counterparts, emphasizing cost-effectiveness while ensuring high sensitivity on defect detection. As semiconductor devices become more complex, the quality of the electron beam (ebeam) in defect inspection tools has become a pivotal factor.
